newsitem.title: UK: A&L links up with Eagle Star for insurance.
newsitem.headline: A&L links up with Eagle Star for insurance.

text.p: Alliance & Leicester Building Society said on Tuesday it would expand its general insurance business through an agreement with Eagle Star.

This arrangement, initially intended to run for three years, will ensure the continuation of household insurance policies and claims processing for Alliance & Leicester customers, the building society said in a statement.

Alliance & Leicester said its current joint arrangement for general insurance provided by Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc and Eagle Star will cease once the new venture is up and running in 1997.

The building society, which plans a stock market flotation next year and wants to covert into a bank, said it intended to extend the range of insurance services it offered to include travel, medical and warranty insurance.

It said that it would use Eagle Star's underwriting expertise to increase its competiveness and was reviewing the potential benefit of participating in underwriting insurance through the Eagle Star agreement.
